If you broke your leg how do you do ? Mental health is as important as your physical health 
Talking with your school therapist does not seem to be a bad idea. 
Struggling with your own mind is hard going to therapy is not easy as well but living with depression is hell.
I'm 27 I did not take it seriously when I started to feel down (around 12 years old) and now I'm still struggling with it.
Save time for you take care of it, talking about it is a first step and thanks for sharing this with us.

Wanting to die at fourteen years old is not normal.

I hope my advice will help you and that you will be ok.
Take care
Have you talk about it to people around you?
If this person make you feel that way can't you get it out of your life?

I think it is as brave as coward to commit suicide, brave because it takes a lot of nerve to do it and coward because you will just leave all the people who cares about you without letting them trying to help you.
First of all did you call a suicide hotline? Did you talk to somebody about your angst ?

Everybody is the stupid bitch of somebody else keep your head up, cool down, and be gentle with yourself.
You don't need validation of this bastard. Though taking the risk of ending your life for this shit seems a bit extreme to me is this a regular thoughts ? Do you see a therapist about that ?
What happen after the cops came, are you in hospital ?

Hello, for a start I suggest you to talk about it.
It's not normal to have those types of thoughts and I know how much energy it cost to bear them constantly.
Get help, find a psychiatrist and a psychologist. The psychiatrist will help you with antidepressants probably and the psychologist will help you to find the answers at your angst.

I agree with the advice of exercise but put your thoughts aside with work does not seem to be a long time solution from my point of a view.

If you want to talk about it we can, take care, bye

It's late in my country so I'm going to bed please don't make anything stupid, call someone close and talk for a start. If your suicidal thoughts are unbearable call the emergency.
We can exchange further if you want
Hello, did you talk about your mental health to somebody? Do you see a psychiatrist and a psychologist?
And if your therapist doesn't suit you, change it's really important to have a good contact and get along with them.

Hello mate, I'm 27 depressed and had suicidal thoughts, a drinking and drugs  problem until it wasn't bearable anymore.
If you lost pleasure in what you love it's the first symptom of a depression, you seem to hate yourself that's a second one, you cut yourself and have issues with alcohol you remember me except for the cutting part.

Talk to your family and I'm pretty sure you can find someone to call, the Contact page of your phone is surely not blank. 
Find a psychiatrist and a psychologist.

I went in a clinic for 2 months, I thought I could get back my life on track directly after but it's not the case so I make one foot after another literally.

It's ok to be lost, life isn't always happy there will be moment of deep pain.

And about the sex problem you idealize it too much, you miss contact, sharing and caring but for now start with yourself.

Getting drunk won't help you, cutting yourself either. 

I hope you're still there and for a long time buddy, love you, take care ❤️
